facts.activity_file: testing earth leakage and protection settings

control_failures.control_label: application of positive isolation devices and personal locks

facts.site: Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop
facts.title: stored energy found after isolation of SG-9000

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 2 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control POSITIVE_ISOLATION_APPLICATION: the application of positive isolation devices and personal locks was not in place, and the root cause analysis classified this as an individual or team action.

recommendations: Confirm at the next field verification that the application of positive isolation devices and personal locks on SG-9000 performs as designed.
response.sequence: Work was under way in maintaining protective systems, specifically testing earth leakage and protection settings. SG-9000 (mine switchgear) is in service for pit and workshop distribution. The task proceeded during cleaning and preparation while the application of positive isolation devices and personal locks was not in place. The electrical energy involved is held as HV switchgear, and the recorded presentation was shock, arc flash, unplanned energisation.
response.summary: On 21 October 2011 a hazard report was recorded on SG-9000 at Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop during cleaning and preparation; electrical energy held as HV switchgear was not released.
